ITEM 1 | Leafy greens, dark green with lighter ruffled edges, slightly wilted and glossy with dressing, forming a loose mound about 9 cm across and 3 cm high at the center of the plate, with thin reddish-pink radish slivers and small pale pieces mixed in | 110
ITEM 2 | Fish-like fillets, pale cream-white flesh with golden-brown crusted edges and flecks of herb or seasoning, arranged as three chunky pieces about 4 cm long and 2 cm thick on the left side of the plate, one partly flaked open showing moist interior | 150
ITEM 3 | Green beans or long green strands, bright green with slight sheen, lying in a small pile about 6 cm long under and beside the fillets, with a few red pepper pieces scattered among them | 35
ITEM 4 | Lemon wedges, bright yellow with pale pith and glossy juicy segments, four to five wedges about 4 cm long each, clustered on the right side of the plate near the cauliflower | 60
ITEM 5 | Cauliflower florets, pale ivory to cream with slightly golden tips, firm and dry-looking, several clusters about 3 to 4 cm across grouped at the lower right of the plate, with a few small reddish pieces tucked in | 120
ITEM 6 | Dressing or oil, a thin glossy sheen coating the greens and fish with no distinct pool, visible as light reflections on the leaves | 8
